description: This file contains TypeScript code for managing and parsing logs, including log line parsing, log state management, and log loading functions.

methods.name: parseMaybeJsonString
methods.description: Parses a string as JSON if it appears to be a JSON object string.

methods.name: normalizeLevel
methods.description: Normalizes a string to a LogLevel if it matches known levels.

methods.name: parseLogLine
methods.description: Parses a log line string into a LogEntry object.

methods.name: loadLogs
methods.description: Asynchronously loads logs into the application state, handling pagination and errors.
